notes.title: Massive Improvements + Upcoming Expansion
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers!

This quality-of-life update brings:
[list]
[*] Over 300 different bug fixes
[*] Huge upgrades to the inventory system
[*] Greatly improved performance
[*] Many tweaks/improvements to different items and game objects
[*] Plus a few hidden extras
[/list] 

Alongside the improvements and fixes released today, we wanted to give you some insights on some things we’ve been working on that will affect the future of Formagetus and beyond!

A new and major DLC is coming! Yes, that’s right, 7 years after the game launched we’ve decided to come back and give you all a massive new expansion to explore! This DLC will introduce an entirely new planet to explore called Formaghetti! Here, Tree will need to put his skills to the test once again to defeat tons of new (and scary) creatures, battle big bad bosses, and push himself to survive the harsh alien landscapes! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8623659/4f5fc281b4cb1757338d71d99589c7ba11ffa108.png[/img]

Nothing is final yet, but based on what we’ve been putting together so far you can expect to face over 20+ new enemies, fight 3+ new bosses, collect 100+ new items, and explore 30+ new areas! Not to mention countless new quests to embark on!

But wait there’s more! We understand that a new DLC might not fit into everyone’s budget, which is why when this update drops (date TBD) we will also be adding a ton of new content to the base game for free! That’s right, if you already own the base game you will gain free access to several new areas, including an icy wasteland and scorching desert! All of this is accompanied by tons of new villagers to meet, new quests to complete, and new enemies to battle!


Follow us on Steam or Twitter to keep up with the action as this new expansion unfolds!
